name: clipugc
description: ClipUGC skills for Claude Code — a UGC ad director (reaction archetypes, hook formulas, casting, prompt library), a persona-account runner for ongoing AI creator accounts (persona definition, content pillars, next-post loop, grid composition), plus the full CLI: create AI characters, generate photorealistic looks, produce silent-reaction video clips, and merge app screen recordings into ready-to-post UGC ads.
